chunks: Jabir narrated from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
"Part of the completeness of hajj is meeting the Imam."

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the divinely designated religious authority
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House

ai.seo_question: How does meeting the Imam relate to the completion of hajj in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the perfection and completion of hajj includes meeting the Imam. It highlights the centrality of the Imam’s religious authority in giving full meaning to the act of pilgrimage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3162 - Jabir narrated from Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"Part of the completeness of Hajj is meeting the Imam."
